nine_slice_note: Regular blank edges allow slicing. Source margins are approx116px (~6px at native fixed-button scale); do not mistake source margins for native UI pixels. Fixed-size button may use the complete visible Atlas region stretched to46x48.
caveats: Alpha1-7 generator noise extends outside the visible contour; recommended Atlas crop uses alpha>=8.
No text/plus/check is baked in. Keep actual interactive icon separate.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / reusable game UI button asset.
The attached image is the exact selected game UI mock and is the authoritative style reference. Recreate ONLY the blank teal/turquoise square add button from the right side of its ingredient rows, with absolutely NO plus sign, NO text, NO symbol or icon. This is a reusable nine-slice button background, not a full interface or screenshot. Match the selected reference's turquoise face, slightly brighter upper-left bevel, darker lower-right bevel, dark teal stepped outline and clipped round-step corners. Keep the face largely smooth and uniform enough to place a white plus or check above it later. Use clean deliberate 16-bit pixel blocks and restrained shading matching the reference; do not substitute a generic flat smooth CSS-like rounded rectangle. Front-facing flat orthographic UI, no perspective, no cast shadow, no three-dimensional scene. Single centered almost-square button with width:height 46:48, generous actual transparent alpha outside its contour. Nine-slice-safe regular edges and blank central face, all ornamental detail confined to edge and corner bands. Tight clear silhouette, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no lettering or watermark.
